description: Record an offline payment against an invoice; the invoice transitions to paid once its balance is settled, and any overpayment becomes client credit.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (must match the invoice's currency)

method.description: Gateway name of an enabled offline payment method (e.g. cash, bank_transfer, credit); cash when omitted

paid_at.description: Date the payment was received (YYYY-MM-DD); today when omitted

name: record_payment
